brief:
Pilot card · UBRG · Tier 3 HIGH, say it at the table · Playtest proxies
 Yidris Triad
 Every spell hits the whole table. Firebending pays, Yidris doubles.
 YIDRIS, MAELSTROM WIELDER
 U B R G 
 Legendary Creature — Ogre Wizard
 Trample. Whenever Yidris deals combat damage to a player , as you cast spells from your hand this turn, they gain cascade . (Exile cards from the top until you exile a nonland card that costs less; you may cast it free. The rest go to the bottom in a random order.)
 Per spell, from hand only. Graveyard, exile and cascaded casts do not cascade.
 5/4 
 ↻ Every turn, in this order
 1
 Land, then ramp
 Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Birds of Paradise, Lotus Cobra, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Rampant Growth, Three Visits, Nature's Lore. Four colours by turn 4.
 2
 Land a pinger
 Guttersnipe, Fiery Inscription, Coruscation Mage or Witherbloom Apprentice by turn 4-5. Now every instant or sorcery hits each opponent.
 3
 Attack
 Yidris, Zuko, Azula, Iroh. Fire Nation Palace gives Yidris firebending 4. The mana lasts until end of combat .
 4
 Get Yidris through
 Before blocks: Leap, Aphotic Wisps, Stun, Shadow Rift, Veil of Secrecy. Firebending mana pays. Hold every other hand spell. 
 5
 After damage: chain
 Hand spells cascade now. Instants in combat, sorceries in second main. Then Iroh recasts the graveyard.
 Forced to choose? Best first: 
 A pinger on board › 
 Yidris damage through › 
 Hand spells after damage › 
 Iroh 
 Rules that decide games
 - Cascade starts at combat damage and is hand-only. Casts from the graveyard (Iroh, Past in Flames) or from exile (Jeska's Will, Eruth) do not cascade.
 - A 1-drop cascades only into Ancestral Vision (the one MV-0 card), if it is still in the library. A 2-drop hits a card at MV 0-1.
 - Firebending mana ends with combat. Spend it on instants, or keep it with Electro. Leyline of Anticipation lets you cast sorceries in combat.
 - Zuko counts every spell you cast during combat. Azula copies only while she is attacking.
 - Iroh's flashback works only during YOUR turn and costs the card's full mana cost.
 - Yidris on the battlefield makes Fierce Guardianship and Deflecting Swat free and gives Jeska's Will both modes.
 Mulligan
 Keep lands + a ramp piece or a pinger. Never keep answers-only.
 Counters and tricks do nothing until a pinger lands.
 Traps
 - A hand spell cast before damage does not cascade. On a swing turn, cast only the connect instant first.
 - Tutor to the top, then cascade: the tutored card is cast free if it costs less than your hand spell. If not, it goes to the bottom.
 - Flubs with cards in hand discards one per land and per spell. Cast him only with 0-1 cards in hand.
 - Fated Firepower flipped by cascade has X = 0. Keep it in hand and flash it in during combat.
 How you win
 Pinger out
 each spell = 1-2 to all
 › 
 Attack
 firebending pays
 › 
 Connect
 hand spells cascade
 › 
 = the count
 about 20 casts
 18 MANA OF SETUP
WIN TURNS 8-10 
 Yidris 4, two pingers 5, a firebender 2-6, protection 2. Then 40 life each is about 20 instants or sorceries with one 2-damage pinger. Best case is one combat: hand spells cascade and Azula copies them. Fated Firepower adds X to every ping. Grapeshot finishes one player. Not table-tested. 
 What breaks it: a board wipe. Save the board with Heroic Intervention, Golgari Charm or Wrap in Vigor, or counter it (Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Counterspell). Lifegain outruns the count: Skullcrack on the kill turn. Graveyard hate stops Iroh.
 At this table
 Justice · Progenitus dinos, Kenrith
 Protection blanks targeted removal. Counter it on the stack; Cyclonic Rift overload does not target. Kenrith: counter Omniscience first, then Chimil (or Abrade it).
 Avery · Tinybones
 Every payoff is an enchantment: Nature's Claim, Golgari Charm, Boseiju, Swan Song. His discard hits the hand you hold for cascade, so cast early and lean on Iroh.
 Dylan · K'rrik
 Sanguine Bond + Exquisite Blood are enchantments: counter one with Swan Song or destroy it. Skullcrack stops the life gain for a turn.
 Harry · five decks
 Drannith Magistrate stops cascade, flashback and exile casts. Kill it on sight: Abrade, Rapid Hybridization, Chaos Warp.
 Before the
first shuffle
 This is tier 3, high power. Every piece of the kill is a permanent on the table or a card in my graveyard. All 100 cards are playtest proxies with the real card name on every face. 
 House rule check: no commander damage. This deck kills by damage to each opponent per spell. Passes.

profile.strategy: Every spell I cast hits the whole table. Land a per-cast pinger (Guttersnipe, Fiery Inscription, Coruscation Mage, Witherbloom Apprentice) by turn 4-5, then each instant or sorcery deals 1-2 to each opponent. Attack with firebenders (Yidris with Fire Nation Palace, Zuko, Azula, Iroh); firebending mana lasts until end of combat. Get Yidris through with a cantrip evasion instant before blocks; after his combat damage every spell cast from hand gains cascade. Hold hand spells until then. Iroh recasts instants and sorceries from the graveyard on my turn. Flubs is a late refill: cast him with 0-1 cards in hand. Protect the board from wipes (Heroic Intervention, Golgari Charm, Wrap in Vigor, Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song); Skullcrack on the kill turn stops lifegain.
